LogLegacySettingsLoaded: Loaded existing TrafikRuler settings; future changes will be saved under AppEgress.
PathMixedEvidence: Multiple network path clues · Expand for details
PathNoConnections: No TCP connections to analyze; another process may handle this application's network.
PathPeerProxy: Related process also connects to a system proxy endpoint: {0} (not attributed to this app)
PathProxyNotObserved: No configured system proxy endpoint matched in the displayed connections; other proxies and billing are unknown.
PathEvidenceLimits: Local peer ownership comes from connection tables. Its other connections are association clues only. Windows route queries do not verify packet transmission or proxy billing.
PathPartialScope: Some connection data is missing or outside the display limit.
PathSharedProxy: Shared proxy upstream cannot be attributed to this application.
PathRelatedLimited: Only the first 8 related connections per local peer are analyzed.
PathSourceMismatch: Source interface and route query differ; actual path needs confirmation.
PathPeerListener: Unique listener candidate: {0} (no matching reverse connection)
PathOtherCount: Other connections of this process: showing {0}/{1}
PathAssociationOnly: These are other connections of the local peer process. They do not prove that it forwards this application's data.
PathPeerUnknown: Local peer process is unknown or ambiguous.
PathSelectConnection: Select a connection to view its local peer's other connections and the evidence details.
MonitorIntro: Observe this application's connections without changing how it connects.
MonitorModeDesc: Shows current TCP connections, UDP local endpoints, route queries and connections to the configured system proxy. Does not route, block or reset traffic.
MonitorSnapshot: Current snapshot {0} · Showing {1} of {2} entries (up to 200)
MonitorReadError: Some tables unavailable ({0}); counts may be incomplete
MonitorProxyOn: Windows system proxy enabled; application use needs endpoint evidence
MonitorProxyOff: Windows manual system proxy off; application-specific proxies remain possible
MonitorCounts: Current TCP: {0} (incl. listeners) · UDP local endpoints: {1} · Speed not sampled
MonitorLimits: Read-only snapshots every second may miss brief connections. TCP includes listeners. Route queries do not prove the physical exit; proxy endpoint matches do not verify protocol or upstream. UDP remote endpoints, proxy upstream, PAC, and DNS handled by system services are not attributed. Unreadable processes may be absent. Endpoints stay in memory, not in the application log.
EmptyText: Choose an application, then select an adapter or monitor its connections without changing its network.
RuleToggleTip: Turn the rule on or off
SetLanDesc: Printers, NAS and your router stay on their usual adapter
SetResetDesc: When a rule is turned on, the app reconnects through the right adapter right away
SetAutostartDesc: Minimized to the tray, without a UAC prompt (via Task Scheduler)
AdapterNotFoundInSystem: Not found in the system right now
RuleIntro: Choose one adapter for this program. Traffic requires a matching Windows route and permission from the VPN client. System DNS is separate.
ProgramPickHint: Pick one of the running programs or specify an exe
PathPlaceholder: Path to an exe, or just its name, e.g. chrome.exe
ByNameToggle: Match by file name only (exe from any folder)
KillSwitchDesc: If the adapter disappears, the program loses network access instead of going through another adapter
RuleEnabledDesc: A disabled rule is kept but has no effect
HintAdapterDown: The adapter is disconnected right now. The rule will start working when it connects.
HintNoIPv4: The adapter has no IPv4 address. The rule will start working when it gets one.
HintNoGateway: No gateway reported. Private-network routes can still work; each destination is checked. VPN access is not yet verified.
HintAdapterReadFailed: Windows could not read this adapter's IP properties. It remains visible, but cannot be used until Refresh succeeds.
HintNoInterfaceIndex: Windows did not report an interface index. This adapter cannot be used for routing yet.
HintRouteCheck: IP address available. Each destination's Windows route is checked; VPN access is not yet verified.
HintNoIPv6: This adapter has no IPv6. IPv6 connections are refused; apps may use IPv4 if supported.
NoProgramText: Pick a program from the running list, use Browse, or type an exe name.
FileNotFoundText: “{0}” does not exist. Save the rule anyway?
NoAdapterText: Select the adapter the program's traffic should go through.
SearchPlaceholder: Search by name, path or window title
ConfirmDeleteText: Traffic of “{0}” will go through the normal route again.
AdminRequiredText: AppEgress intercepts network traffic, so it must be run as administrator.
TrayHintTitle: AppEgress is running in the tray
TrayHintText: Rules keep working. Use the tray icon menu to exit.
StateWaitingLong: adapter unavailable, traffic uses the normal route
ErrDllMissing: WinDivert.dll was not found next to AppEgress.exe. {0}
ErrDriverMissing: The WinDivert64.sys driver was not found next to AppEgress.exe (ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND).
ErrAccessDenied: Access denied: AppEgress must be run as administrator (ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED).
ErrBadSignature: Windows rejected the WinDivert driver signature (ERROR_INVALID_IMAGE_HASH). The file may be damaged or blocked by antivirus software.
ErrOtherVersion: A different version of the WinDivert driver is already loaded (ERROR_DRIVER_FAILED_PRIOR_UNLOAD). Close programs that use WinDivert or restart the computer.
ErrServiceMissing: The WinDivert driver service is not installed (ERROR_SERVICE_DOES_NOT_EXIST).
ErrDriverBlocked: Loading the WinDivert driver was blocked (ERROR_DRIVER_BLOCKED), usually by antivirus software or a security policy.
ErrBfe: The Base Filtering Engine (BFE) service is not running (EPT_S_NOT_REGISTERED).
ErrWinDivertOther: Could not open WinDivert, error code {0}: {1}
LogSettingsReadFailed: Could not read settings, using defaults: {0}
LogAutostartFailed: Could not change Start with Windows: {0}
LogCaptureStopped: Traffic capture stopped: no active rules.
LogRouteUnavailable: {0}: could not verify a Windows route through {1}. Traffic blocked; no automatic fallback. Check the VPN's routes and policy.
